people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.
translations.bsb: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.
translations.kjv: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
translations.asv: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. And he gave their asses provender.
